asset.synopsis: Package asset is the catalogue and the image pipeline of gift: stable identities, metadata, the ordered collection a gallery is a view of, and the application wide service that turns a path or a URL into a decoded, oriented, cached thumbnail.

BackoffPolicy.synopsis: BackoffPolicy governs how a failing source is retried.

BudgetStats.synopsis: BudgetStats is one byte budget at one instant.

Collection.synopsis: Collection is an ordered catalogue of entries with stable IDs.

constructors.name: NewCollection
constructors.synopsis: NewCollection returns a collection over items.

methods.name: ApplyCorrections
methods.synopsis: ApplyCorrections folds a batch of late arriving facts into the catalogue and reports how many entries actually changed.

methods.name: At
methods.synopsis: At returns the metadata of entry i.

methods.name: DimensionsAt
methods.synopsis: DimensionsAt returns the oriented pixel size of entry i, or zeroes when it is not known yet.

methods.name: Find
methods.synopsis: Find returns the position of the entry with the given ID.

methods.name: ID
methods.synopsis: ID returns the stable identity of entry i, which is the cheap half of Collection.At and the one the frame path uses.

methods.name: Len
methods.synopsis: Len is the number of entries.

methods.name: MetadataVersion
methods.synopsis: MetadataVersion is the version of the *contents* of the entries: their dimensions and their revisions.

methods.name: Reorder
methods.synopsis: Reorder applies a new order given as positions into the current one: after the call, entry i is the entry that used to be at order[i].

methods.name: Reset
methods.synopsis: Reset replaces the whole catalogue and bumps both versions.

methods.name: Revision
methods.synopsis: Revision returns the content version of entry i; see Metadata.Revision.

methods.name: StructureVersion
methods.synopsis: StructureVersion is the version of the *shape* of the catalogue: which entries exist and in which order.

Config.decl:
type Config struct {
	Workers           int
	Sizes             []int
	Hysteresis        float64
	MaxPixels         int
	MaxEncodedBytes   int64
	InputBudget       int64
	DecodeBudget      int64
	PixelBudget       int64

}

Correction.synopsis: Correction is a late arriving fact about one entry, addressed by its stable ID rather than by its position.

Decoder.synopsis: Decoder turns encoded bytes into an image.

DiskCacheConfig.synopsis: DiskCacheConfig configures the persistent thumbnail cache of the project plan, section 9, point 4.

DiskCacheStats.synopsis: DiskCacheStats are the persistent cache counters.
DiskCacheStats.decl:
type DiskCacheStats struct {
	Enabled                 bool
	Hits, Misses            uint64
	Writes, Evictions       uint64
	Corrupt                 uint64
	Errors                  uint64
	BytesRead, BytesWritten uint64
	SweptTemps              uint64
	Bytes                   int64
	Entries                 int
	Budget                  int64
}

FetchResult.synopsis: FetchResult is the answer to a conditional fetch.
FetchResult.decl:
type FetchResult struct {
	NotModified bool
	Revision    string
	Size        int64
	MIMEType    string
	Fresh       time.Duration
	Body        io.ReadCloser
}

Fetcher.synopsis: Fetcher is the optional extension for a source whose revision only becomes known by asking for the bytes, and which can be asked conditionally: HTTP.

FileSource.synopsis: FileSource is a picture in the local file system.

constructors.name: File
constructors.synopsis: File returns a source for the picture at path.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.synopsis: Metadata returns the identity and the guessed media type.

methods.name: Open
methods.synopsis: Open opens the file for reading.

methods.name: Path
methods.synopsis: Path is the cleaned absolute path.

methods.name: Probe
methods.synopsis: Probe stats the file.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String is the redacted description used in diagnostics.

HTTPSource.synopsis: HTTPSource is a picture behind an HTTP or HTTPS URL.

constructors.name: HTTP
constructors.synopsis: HTTP returns a source for the picture at rawURL.

methods.name: CacheNamespace
methods.synopsis: CacheNamespace is the credential fingerprint; see Namespacer.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.synopsis: Fetch performs a conditional GET; see Fetcher.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.synopsis: Metadata returns the redacted identity.

methods.name: Open
methods.synopsis: Open performs an unconditional GET.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String is the redacted URL.

methods.name: WithClient
methods.synopsis: WithClient sets the HTTP client.

methods.name: WithCredential
methods.synopsis: WithCredential adds an opaque credential fingerprint to the cache namespace without sending anything.

methods.name: WithHeader
methods.synopsis: WithHeader adds a request header.

methods.name: WithPublicQuery
methods.synopsis: WithPublicQuery names query parameters that are safe to keep legible in the identity, for example a width or a format.

methods.name: WithSecretQuery
methods.synopsis: WithSecretQuery declares query parameters as credentials.

ID.synopsis: ID is the stable identity of one catalogue entry.

Key.decl:
type Key struct {
	Namespace         string
	ID                ID
	Revision          string
	Size              int
	Orientation       Orientation
	ProcessingVersion uint32
}

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String is a stable, printable form of the key.

Metadata.synopsis: Metadata is what is known about one entry without opening it.

methods.name: HasDimensions
methods.synopsis: HasDimensions reports whether both dimensions are known.

Namespacer.synopsis: Namespacer is the optional extension for a source that must not share cache entries with other sources of the same URL.

Orientation.synopsis: Orientation is the EXIF orientation of a picture: how the stored pixel grid has to be transformed to be shown the right way up.

methods.name: Normalised
methods.synopsis: Normalised maps OrientationUnknown and any out of range value to OrientationTopLeft.

methods.name: Oriented
methods.synopsis: Oriented returns the presentation dimensions of a stored grid of w by h.

methods.name: SwapsAxes
methods.synopsis: SwapsAxes reports whether applying this orientation exchanges width and height.

Pipeline.synopsis: Pipeline is the application wide image service of the project plan, section 9.

constructors.name: NewPipeline
constructors.synopsis: NewPipeline starts a pipeline with cfg.

methods.name: Close
methods.synopsis: Close stops the workers and releases everything the pipeline holds.

methods.name: Forget
methods.synopsis: Forget clears the failure state of a source, so that the next request for it is attempted again.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.synopsis: Invalidate drops every cached thumbnail of one picture from memory and forgets its revision hint, so the next request revalidates.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.synopsis: Lookup answers "do I already have this, right now" without scheduling anything.

methods.name: Request
methods.synopsis: Request schedules work and returns a ticket that can cancel it.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the counters.

Priority.synopsis: Priority is the two level scheduling class of the project plan, section 9: "Sichtbare Bilder haben Vorrang vor richtungsabhaengigem Prefetch."

ProbeResult.synopsis: ProbeResult is what a Prober learned about a source without transferring its bytes.

Prober.synopsis: Prober is the optional extension for a source whose revision is cheap to establish: a local file, where a probe is a stat.

Request.synopsis: Request is one demand for a thumbnail.
Request.decl:
type Request struct {
	Source     Source
	Size       int
	Priority   Priority
	Generation uint64
	OnResult   func(Result)
}

Result.synopsis: Result is the answer to one Request.
Result.decl:
type Result struct {
	ID                   ID
	Generation           uint64
	Size                 int
	Image                *Thumbnail
	Metadata             Metadata
	Orientation          Orientation
	Retry, Failure       error
	ImageWithheld        bool
	FromDisk, FromMemory bool
}

methods.name: Correction
methods.synopsis: Correction turns the metadata of a result into a catalogue correction, so that probed dimensions reach the gallery the way section 10 requires: by stable ID, in a batch.

methods.name: Err
methods.synopsis: Err returns whichever of Result.Failure and Result.Retry is set, or nil.

methods.name: OK
methods.synopsis: OK reports whether the request produced a picture.

ScaledDecoder.synopsis: ScaledDecoder is an optional extension of Decoder: a decoder that can produce a smaller picture than the stored one directly, for less work than decoding all of it.

Selection.synopsis: Selection is the durable selection and keyboard cursor of a catalogue.

constructors.name: NewSelection
constructors.synopsis: NewSelection returns an empty selection.

methods.name: Anchor
methods.synopsis: Anchor is the fixed end of a range extension; see Selection.SelectRange.

methods.name: Clear
methods.synopsis: Clear deselects everything, leaving the cursor where it is, and reports whether anything changed.

methods.name: Contains
methods.synopsis: Contains reports whether id is selected.

methods.name: Cursor
methods.synopsis: Cursor is the entry the keyboard focus of the gallery is on, or the empty ID when there is none.

methods.name: IDs
methods.synopsis: IDs appends every selected ID to dst and returns the extended slice.

methods.name: Len
methods.synopsis: Len is the number of selected entries.

methods.name: Only
methods.synopsis: Only makes id the entire selection and puts the cursor and the range anchor on it.

methods.name: Prune
methods.synopsis: Prune drops every selected ID and every cursor that c no longer contains, and reports whether anything was dropped.

methods.name: SelectRange
methods.synopsis: SelectRange replaces the selection with the entries from the anchor to id, inclusive, in the order c defines.

methods.name: Set
methods.synopsis: Set selects or deselects id and reports whether anything changed.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.synopsis: SetCursor moves the cursor and, unless keepAnchor, the range anchor with it.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.synopsis: Toggle flips the state of id and reports the new state.

methods.name: Version
methods.synopsis: Version increases whenever the selection or the cursor changed.

Sniffer.synopsis: Sniffer is an optional extension of Decoder: a decoder that can recognise its own format from the first bytes.

Source.synopsis: Source is one addressable picture: what is known about it without opening it, and a way to open it.

Stats.synopsis: Stats is a snapshot of the pipeline's counters.
Stats.decl:
type Stats struct {
	Requests                                   uint64
	Deduplicated                               uint64
	Promotions                                 uint64
	Dropped, Cancelled                         uint64
	ReadyDropped                               uint64
	Completed, Failed                          uint64
	BackoffRefused, Quarantined                uint64
	Decodes, MemoryHits, DiskHits, NotModified uint64
	DecodedPixels, ScaledPixels                uint64
	Input, Decode, Pixels                      BudgetStats
	CacheEntries                               int
	CacheHits, CacheMisses, CacheEvictions     uint64
	QueuedVisible, QueuedPrefetch, InFlight    int
	Disk                                       DiskCacheStats
}

StatusError.synopsis: StatusError is a non-OK HTTP status.

methods.name: Temporary
methods.synopsis: Temporary reports whether retrying could plausibly help.

Thumbnail.synopsis: Thumbnail is one decoded, oriented, scaled picture in main memory.

methods.name: Bounds
methods.synopsis: Bounds is the pixel rectangle, always anchored at the origin.

methods.name: Bytes
methods.synopsis: Bytes is the size of the pixel data, which is what the budget accounts.

methods.name: LadderSize
methods.synopsis: LadderSize is the rung of Config.Sizes this thumbnail was produced for.

methods.name: Orientation
methods.synopsis: Orientation is the EXIF orientation that was *applied*.

methods.name: Pix
methods.synopsis: Pix is the premultiplied RGBA pixel data, or nil after the last release.

methods.name: RGBA
methods.synopsis: RGBA returns an image.RGBA view of the same pixels, without copying.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release drops a reference and frees the pixels when it was the last one.

methods.name: Retain
methods.synopsis: Retain adds a reference.

methods.name: Revision
methods.synopsis: Revision is the content version these pixels were produced from, or empty for a source that has none.

methods.name: Stride
methods.synopsis: Stride is the distance between two rows in bytes.

methods.name: Width
methods.synopsis: Width and Height are the oriented pixel dimensions.

Ticket.synopsis: Ticket is a handle on an accepted request.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.synopsis: Cancel withdraws the request.

funcs.name: RegisterDecoder
funcs.synopsis: RegisterDecoder registers a decoder for a media type, replacing any earlier registration of the same type.

funcs.name: Retryable
funcs.synopsis: Retryable classifies a pipeline error for a consumer.

ebiten.synopsis: Package ebiten is gift's Ebitengine backend: the window, the frame loop and the GPU output.

AtlasStats.synopsis: AtlasStats are the glyph atlas counters.
AtlasStats.decl:
type AtlasStats struct {
	Hits, Misses                              uint64
	Rasterised                                uint64
	Blanks                                    uint64
	UploadedBytes                             uint64
	PagesCreated, PageEvictions, AgeEvictions uint64
	GlyphEvictions                            uint64
	Rejected                                  uint64
	RejectedRasterised                        uint64
	Pages, Glyphs                             int

}

Config.synopsis: Config configures the window and the frame loop of Run.

	Title                         string
	X11ClassName, X11InstanceName string
	Width, Height                 int
	Logger                        *slog.Logger
	TPS                           int
	IdleTPS                       int
	IdleFrames                    int

Frame.synopsis: Frame is declared in both files so that the signatures above are legal without the tag.

GlassPolicy.synopsis: GlassPolicy chooses between render.Reduced and render.Full.

constructors.name: NewGlassPolicy
constructors.synopsis: NewGlassPolicy returns a policy at render.Full, unpinned.

methods.name: AddArea
methods.synopsis: AddArea accumulates the device pixel area of one material region of the frame in progress.

methods.name: BeginFrame
methods.synopsis: BeginFrame moves the policy on by one drawn frame and returns the level the frame is drawn at.

methods.name: IsPinned
methods.synopsis: IsPinned reports whether a level is pinned.

methods.name: Level
methods.synopsis: Level returns the effective quality level.

methods.name: Median
methods.synopsis: Median returns the median of the window, or zero while it is empty.

methods.name: Pin
methods.synopsis: Pin fixes the effective level.

methods.name: RecordInterval
methods.synopsis: RecordInterval adds one interval between drawn frames to the window.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the policy counters.

methods.name: TakeLevelChange
methods.synopsis: TakeLevelChange reports the level the policy last switched to and clears the flag, so that every change is reported exactly once and a run that did not change reports nothing.

methods.name: Unpin
methods.synopsis: Unpin returns control to the measurements.

GlassPolicyConfig.synopsis: GlassPolicyConfig configures the measurement based GlassPolicy.
GlassPolicyConfig.decl:
type GlassPolicyConfig struct {
	Window                   int
	DownInterval, UpInterval time.Duration
	MinDwellFrames           int
	MaxAreaFraction          float64
	UpAreaFraction           float64
	AreaWindow               int
}

GlassPolicyStats.synopsis: GlassPolicyStats are the counters of the policy.
GlassPolicyStats.decl:
type GlassPolicyStats struct {
	EffectiveLevel                                render.GlassQuality
	Pinned                                        bool
	Changes, Downgrades, AreaDowngrades, Upgrades uint64
	MedianInterval                                time.Duration
	AreaFraction                                  float64
	SubFrameIntervals                             uint64
}

GlyphAtlas.synopsis: GlyphAtlas packs rasterised glyph coverage into a bounded set of eb.Image pages.

constructors.name: NewGlyphAtlas
constructors.synopsis: NewGlyphAtlas returns an empty atlas.

methods.name: Entry
methods.synopsis: Entry returns the packed rectangle and bearing of an entry obtained from GlyphAtlas.Lookup.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.synopsis: Lookup returns the entry index for a glyph, rasterising and packing it if it is not cached yet, and reports whether the glyph could be resolved at all.

methods.name: Page
methods.synopsis: Page returns the image an entry lives on.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the atlas counters.

methods.name: Tick
methods.synopsis: Tick advances the frame clock and evicts pages that have gone unread for longer than AtlasConfig.MaxAge.

LayerStats.synopsis: LayerStats are the counters of the layer cache.
LayerStats.decl:
type LayerStats struct {
	Composites             uint64
	Hits, Draws            uint64
	Reused                 uint64
	Through                uint64
	Allocations, Evictions uint64
	Resident               int
}

Material.synopsis: Material is what a batch is drawn with.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String makes a failing test readable.

Renderer.synopsis: Renderer is the render.Backend implementation on top of Ebitengine.

constructors.name: NewRenderer
constructors.synopsis: NewRenderer compiles the shape shader and returns a renderer.

methods.name: Atlas
methods.synopsis: Atlas returns the glyph atlas of this renderer, for GlyphAtlas.Stats and for a test that wants to configure the budget.

methods.name: BeginFrame
methods.synopsis: BeginFrame implements render.Backend.

methods.name: EndFrame
methods.synopsis: EndFrame implements render.Backend.

methods.name: GlassLevel
methods.synopsis: GlassLevel returns the policy's current effective level.

methods.name: GlassPolicy
methods.synopsis: GlassPolicy returns the adaptive quality policy.

methods.name: Images
methods.synopsis: Images returns the image resource service of this renderer.

methods.name: LayerStats
methods.synopsis: LayerStats returns the counters of the layer cache.

methods.name: NeedsFrame
methods.synopsis: NeedsFrame reports whether the frame last drawn left work that only another frame can finish: picture uploads the per frame budget deferred.

methods.name: PinGlassQuality
methods.synopsis: PinGlassQuality fixes the effective glass level, or returns to the adaptive policy when given render.Adaptive.

methods.name: SetAtlas
methods.synopsis: SetAtlas replaces the glyph atlas.

methods.name: SetFinalTarget
methods.synopsis: SetFinalTarget draws the frame straight into Ebitengine's final screen instead of an offscreen; see Config.DirectToScreen.

methods.name: SetGlassPolicy
methods.synopsis: SetGlassPolicy replaces the policy.

methods.name: SetLayerCache
methods.synopsis: SetLayerCache turns the layer cache on, which is the default, or off.

methods.name: SetStaticBackdrops
methods.synopsis: SetStaticBackdrops turns static backdrops on, which is the default, or off.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.synopsis: SetTarget selects the image the next frame is drawn into.

methods.name: SetTargets
methods.synopsis: SetTargets replaces the target pool.

methods.name: SetTextures
methods.synopsis: SetTextures replaces the texture cache.

methods.name: SkipFrame
methods.synopsis: SkipFrame tells the renderer that a display refresh went by without a frame being drawn, because nothing had changed; see Config.DrawOnDemand.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns the renderer counters.

methods.name: Submit
methods.synopsis: Submit implements render.Backend.

methods.name: Targets
methods.synopsis: Targets returns the intermediate render target pool, for TargetStats and for a test that wants a small budget in order to observe reuse, rejection and release.

methods.name: Textures
methods.synopsis: Textures returns the texture cache, for TextureStats and for a test that wants a small budget in order to observe admission and eviction.

methods.name: Accounted
methods.synopsis: Accounted is Ops + Skipped + UnknownKinds + Layers.Reused + Layers.Through.

methods.name: Skipped
methods.synopsis: Skipped is the total number of operations that produced no geometry.

TargetPool.synopsis: TargetPool owns the intermediate render targets of the glass material.

constructors.name: NewTargetPool
constructors.synopsis: NewTargetPool returns an empty pool.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.synopsis: Acquire leases a target at least w by h pixels, reusing a pooled one when the bucketed size matches.

methods.name: Close
methods.synopsis: Close deallocates every target the pool holds, leased or not.

methods.name: Leased
methods.synopsis: Leased reports how many targets are currently leased.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release returns a leased target to the pool.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the counters.

methods.name: Tick
methods.synopsis: Tick advances the frame clock and deallocates targets that have gone unused for longer than TargetConfig.MaxAge.

TargetStats.synopsis: TargetStats are the counters of the target pool.

type TargetStats struct {
	Leases, Reuses             uint64
	Allocations, Deallocations uint64
	Evictions, AgeEvictions    uint64
	Rejected                   uint64
	Malformed                  uint64
	ClosedWhileLeased          uint64
	Targets                    int
	Bytes                      int64
	PeakTargets                int
	PeakBytes                  int64
}

TextureCache.synopsis: TextureCache is the image resource service of this backend: residency, admission and eviction of decoded pictures on the GPU.

constructors.name: NewTextureCache
constructors.synopsis: NewTextureCache returns an empty cache.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.synopsis: Acquire implements render.Images.

methods.name: BeginFrame
methods.synopsis: BeginFrame resets the per drawn frame upload budget.

methods.name: Deallocate
methods.synopsis: Deallocate implements render.Images.

methods.name: Deferred
methods.synopsis: Deferred reports how many uploads the budget turned away in the frame last drawn.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.synopsis: Resolve implements render.Images.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the counters.

methods.name: Tick
methods.synopsis: Tick advances the frame clock and evicts textures that have gone undrawn for longer than TextureConfig.MaxAge.
