funcs.name: GlassShaderSource
funcs.synopsis: GlassShaderSource returns the Kage source of the glass composite shader, and KawaseShaderSources the two blur passes, under the same rule as ShapeShaderSource: compiling them is a CPU operation and a test may do it headless.

funcs.name: KawaseShaderSources
funcs.synopsis: KawaseShaderSources returns the downsample and upsample shaders of the dual-Kawase chain.

funcs.name: RoundImageShaderSource
funcs.synopsis: RoundImageShaderSource returns the Kage source of the rounded picture shader, under the same rule as ShapeShaderSource.

funcs.name: Run
funcs.synopsis: Run opens a window and drives app until it is closed.

funcs.name: ShapeShaderSource
funcs.synopsis: ShapeShaderSource returns the Kage source of the shared shape shader.

filepicker.synopsis: Package filepicker is a file picker made of gift views: it opens one or several files, chooses a directory or picks a path to save to, inside the application's own window and on a touchscreen as well as with a mouse and a keyboard.

Mode.synopsis: Mode is what the picker picks.

PickerView.synopsis: PickerView is the declaration of a file picker.

constructors.name: New
constructors.signature: New(fsys fs.FS, onPick func(paths []string), onCancel func()) PickerView
constructors.synopsis: New returns a picker over fsys that calls onPick with the picked paths and onCancel when the person backs out.

methods.name: Extensions
methods.synopsis: Extensions limits the files that can be picked to these extensions, ignoring case: ".jpg" and "JPG" are the same.

methods.name: Filter
methods.synopsis: Filter limits the files that can be picked to those fn accepts, on top of PickerView.Extensions.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the picker take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Logger
methods.synopsis: Logger sets where a directory that cannot be read is reported.

methods.name: Mode
methods.synopsis: Mode sets what the picker picks; see Mode.

methods.name: RootLabel
methods.synopsis: RootLabel sets the name of the root in the path bar.

methods.name: ShowHidden
methods.synopsis: ShowHidden lists the entries whose name starts with a dot.

methods.name: Start
methods.synopsis: Start sets the directory the picker opens in, as an fs.FS path.

methods.name: SuggestedName
methods.synopsis: SuggestedName fills the name field of Save mode when the picker is mounted.

methods.name: Title
methods.synopsis: Title sets the line in the middle of the header.

geom.synopsis: Package geom provides the numeric geometry primitives shared by the layout, input and rendering layers of gift.

Affine2D.synopsis: Affine2D is a 2D affine transform stored as a 2x3 matrix:
Affine2D.decl: type Affine2D struct{ A, B, C, D, TX, TY float32 }

constructors.name: Identity
constructors.synopsis: Identity returns the transform that leaves every point unchanged.

constructors.name: Rotate
constructors.synopsis: Rotate returns the transform that rotates about the origin by the given angle in radians.

constructors.name: Scale
constructors.synopsis: Scale returns the transform that scales x by sx and y by sy about the origin.

constructors.name: Translate
constructors.synopsis: Translate returns the transform that moves every point by d.

methods.name: Apply
methods.synopsis: Apply returns p transformed by m.

methods.name: Det
methods.synopsis: Det returns the determinant of the linear part of m.

methods.name: Invert
methods.synopsis: Invert returns the inverse of m and true, or the zero Affine2D and false if m is singular.

methods.name: IsAxisAligned
methods.synopsis: IsAxisAligned reports whether the linear part of m maps the coordinate axes onto themselves, so that m is a combination of a translation and a scale with no rotation and no skew.

methods.name: IsIdentity
methods.synopsis: IsIdentity reports whether m leaves every point unchanged.

methods.name: IsTranslationOnly
methods.synopsis: IsTranslationOnly reports whether the linear part of m is the identity, so that m is a pure translation.

methods.name: Mul
methods.synopsis: Mul returns the transform that applies m first and n afterwards.

methods.name: ScaleFactors
methods.synopsis: ScaleFactors returns how much m stretches a unit length along the local x and y axis.

methods.name: TransformRect
methods.synopsis: TransformRect returns the axis aligned bounding box of the four transformed corners of r.

Alignment.synopsis: Alignment places a child inside a larger rectangle.
Alignment.decl: type Alignment struct{ X, Y float32 }

methods.name: Position
methods.synopsis: Position returns the rectangle of size child placed inside within according to a.

Constraints.synopsis: Constraints is the size range a parent imposes on a child during layout.
Constraints.decl: type Constraints struct{ Min, Max Size }

constructors.name: Loose
constructors.synopsis: Loose returns Constraints with a zero minimum and s as maximum.

constructors.name: Tight
constructors.synopsis: Tight returns Constraints that admit exactly the size s.

constructors.name: Unconstrained
constructors.synopsis: Unconstrained returns Constraints with a zero minimum and an Unbounded maximum on both axes.

methods.name: Constrain
methods.synopsis: Constrain returns s clamped into the range described by c.

methods.name: ConstrainHeight
methods.synopsis: ConstrainHeight returns h clamped into the vertical range of c.

methods.name: ConstrainWidth
methods.synopsis: ConstrainWidth returns w clamped into the horizontal range of c.

methods.name: Deflate
methods.synopsis: Deflate returns c reduced by the insets i, as required when a padding modifier forwards constraints to its child.

methods.name: HasBoundedHeight
methods.synopsis: HasBoundedHeight reports whether the vertical maximum is finite.

methods.name: HasBoundedWidth
methods.synopsis: HasBoundedWidth reports whether the horizontal maximum is finite.

methods.name: IsNormalized
methods.synopsis: IsNormalized reports whether c is well formed: no component is negative or NaN, Min is finite, and Min is component wise less than or equal to Max.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedBy
methods.synopsis: IsSatisfiedBy reports whether s lies within the range described by c, inclusive on both ends.

methods.name: Loosen
methods.synopsis: Loosen returns c with its minimum dropped to zero and its maximum unchanged.

methods.name: Tighten
methods.synopsis: Tighten returns Constraints that admit exactly c.Constrain(s).

Insets.synopsis: Insets is a per edge padding or margin in view space.
Insets.decl: type Insets struct{ Top, Right, Bottom, Left float32 }

constructors.name: InsetsAll
constructors.synopsis: InsetsAll returns Insets with the same value v on all four edges.

constructors.name: InsetsSymmetric
constructors.synopsis: InsetsSymmetric returns Insets with vertical applied to the top and bottom edge and horizontal applied to the left and right edge.

methods.name: Add
methods.synopsis: Add returns the component wise sum of i and j.

methods.name: Horizontal
methods.synopsis: Horizontal returns Left plus Right, the total width consumed by i.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether all four edges are exactly zero.

methods.name: Vertical
methods.synopsis: Vertical returns Top plus Bottom, the total height consumed by i.

Point.synopsis: Point is a position in view space.
Point.decl: type Point struct{ X, Y float32 }

constructors.name: Pt
constructors.synopsis: Pt returns the Point at x, y.

methods.name: Add
methods.synopsis: Add returns the component wise sum of p and q.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether both components are exactly zero.

methods.name: Mul
methods.synopsis: Mul returns p with both components scaled by s.

methods.name: Sub
methods.synopsis: Sub returns the component wise difference p minus q.

Rect.synopsis: Rect is an axis aligned rectangle in view space.
Rect.decl: type Rect struct{ Min, Max Point }

constructors.name: Rc
constructors.signature: Rc(minX, minY, maxX, maxY float32) Rect
constructors.synopsis: Rc returns the Rect spanning from minX, minY to maxX, maxY. The corners are used as given; call Canon if they may be swapped.

constructors.name: RcSize
constructors.synopsis: RcSize returns the Rect with the given origin and size.

constructors.name: RcXYWH
constructors.signature: RcXYWH(x, y, w, h float32) Rect
constructors.synopsis: RcXYWH returns the Rect with origin x, y and extent w, h.

methods.name: Canon
methods.synopsis: Canon returns r with its corners normalised so that Min is component wise less than or equal to Max.

methods.name: Contains
methods.synopsis: Contains reports whether p lies inside r.

methods.name: Height
methods.synopsis: Height returns the vertical extent of r.

methods.name: Inset
methods.synopsis: Inset returns r shrunk by i on each edge.

methods.name: Intersect
methods.synopsis: Intersect returns the rectangle covered by both r and s.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.synopsis: IsEmpty reports whether r covers no area, that is whether its width or its height is not strictly positive.

methods.name: Origin
methods.synopsis: Origin returns the minimum corner of r.

methods.name: Outset
methods.synopsis: Outset returns r grown by i on each edge.

methods.name: Overlaps
methods.synopsis: Overlaps reports whether r and s share at least one point of positive area.

methods.name: Size
methods.synopsis: Size returns the extent of r.

methods.name: Translate
methods.synopsis: Translate returns r moved by d.

methods.name: Union
methods.synopsis: Union returns the smallest rectangle containing both r and s.

methods.name: Width
methods.synopsis: Width returns the horizontal extent of r.

Size.synopsis: Size is a width and a height in view space.
Size.decl: type Size struct{ W, H float32 }

constructors.name: Sz
constructors.synopsis: Sz returns the Size with width w and height h.

methods.name: Add
methods.synopsis: Add returns the component wise sum of s and t.

methods.name: Inset
methods.synopsis: Inset returns s shrunk by the insets i.

methods.name: IsFinite
methods.synopsis: IsFinite reports whether both components are neither infinite nor NaN. A Size containing Unbounded is therefore not finite.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether both components are exactly zero.

methods.name: Outset
methods.synopsis: Outset returns s grown by the insets i.

methods.name: Sub
methods.synopsis: Sub returns the component wise difference s minus t.

funcs.name: Unbounded
funcs.synopsis: Unbounded returns the sentinel used for a constraint maximum that imposes no upper limit.

gift.synopsis: Package gift is the runtime core of the gift UI toolkit.

App.synopsis: App owns one user interface: the retained tree, the component scopes, the state and the display list.

constructors.name: New
constructors.synopsis: New creates an App and mounts the root component.

methods.name: BeginInput
methods.synopsis: BeginInput opens the input phase of one tick and advances the clock to now.

methods.name: Density
methods.synopsis: Density returns the device density in force, which is always an integer of at least one.

methods.name: Diagnostics
methods.synopsis: Diagnostics returns a snapshot of the counters as of the end of the last Update or Paint.

methods.name: DismissSoftKeyboard
methods.synopsis: DismissSoftKeyboard puts gift's on-screen keyboard away by blurring whatever asked for it, and reports whether there was a keyboard up.

methods.name: DrainPosts
methods.synopsis: DrainPosts runs everything posted since the last update, outside a frame.

methods.name: Focus
methods.synopsis: Focus returns the node that currently holds the keyboard focus, and whether anything does.

methods.name: FocusVisible
methods.synopsis: FocusVisible reports whether the current focus should be shown as a ring, which is the case when it was installed by the keyboard rather than by a pointer; see Interaction.FocusVisible.

methods.name: HitTest
methods.synopsis: HitTest returns the topmost interactive node at the device space point p, and whether there is one.

methods.name: Images
methods.synopsis: Images returns the service installed by App.SetImages, or nil.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.synopsis: Invalidate forces a rebuild of the root component in the next update.

methods.name: InvalidateAll
methods.synopsis: InvalidateAll forces a rebuild of *every* mounted component instance in the next update, not only of the root.

methods.name: IsScrollable
methods.synopsis: IsScrollable reports whether r is a scroll container.

methods.name: KeyDown
methods.synopsis: KeyDown reports a key press.

methods.name: KeyUp
methods.synopsis: KeyUp reports a key release, delivered like App.KeyDown but never acted on by gift itself beyond ending a repeat.

methods.name: Logger
methods.synopsis: Logger returns the logger passed in Options, or nil.

methods.name: MoveFocus
methods.synopsis: MoveFocus moves the keyboard focus to the next focusable node in document order, or to the previous one when forward is false, and reports whether the focus changed.

methods.name: NeedsPaint
methods.synopsis: NeedsPaint reports whether the tree changed since the last Paint.

methods.name: NodeBounds
methods.synopsis: NodeBounds returns the absolute rectangle of the referenced node as of the last layout pass, or the zero Rect for a stale reference.

methods.name: NodeChildren
methods.synopsis: NodeChildren appends the children of r to dst, in order, and returns the extended slice.

methods.name: NodeDeviceBounds
methods.synopsis: NodeDeviceBounds returns the rectangle of the node in device space: its layout bounds mapped through the transforms of its ancestors, which today means through the scroll offsets above it.

methods.name: NodeFocusable
methods.synopsis: NodeFocusable reports whether the node may currently hold the keyboard focus, that is whether it would be visited by App.MoveFocus.

methods.name: NodeInteraction
methods.synopsis: NodeInteraction returns the hover, press, focus and disabled state of the referenced node.

methods.name: NodeInteractive
methods.synopsis: NodeInteractive reports whether the node takes part in hit testing, that is whether its element carried an Interactor.

methods.name: NodeKey
methods.synopsis: NodeKey returns the reconciliation key of the referenced node, or the empty string for an unkeyed or stale reference.

methods.name: NodeLabel
methods.synopsis: NodeLabel returns Element.Label of the node, or the empty string for a node that declared none and for a stale reference.

methods.name: NodeOverflow
methods.synopsis: NodeOverflow returns by how much the content of r exceeds the size r reported, and whether it overflows at all.

methods.name: NodeParent
methods.synopsis: NodeParent returns the parent of r, or the zero NodeRef for the root and for a stale reference.

methods.name: NodeScroller
methods.synopsis: NodeScroller returns the nearest scroll container at or above r, and whether there is one.

methods.name: NodeType
methods.synopsis: NodeType returns the TypeID of the view the node was built from, or the zero TypeID for a stale reference.

methods.name: NodeValid
methods.synopsis: NodeValid reports whether r still refers to a live node.

methods.name: NodeVisibleBounds
methods.synopsis: NodeVisibleBounds returns the part of the node that survives the clips of its ancestors, and whether any of it does.

methods.name: Paint
methods.synopsis: Paint produces the display list of this frame.

methods.name: PointerCancel
methods.synopsis: PointerCancel ends the pointer id without a release.

methods.name: PointerDown
methods.signature: PointerDown(id PointerID, kind PointerKind, pos geom.Point)
methods.synopsis: PointerDown reports a press of the pointer id at pos.

methods.name: PointerMove
methods.signature: PointerMove(id PointerID, kind PointerKind, pos geom.Point)
methods.synopsis: PointerMove reports that the pointer id moved to pos, in device space.

methods.name: PointerUp
methods.signature: PointerUp(id PointerID, kind PointerKind, pos geom.Point)
methods.synopsis: PointerUp reports a release of the pointer id at pos.

methods.name: PointerWheel
methods.synopsis: PointerWheel reports a scroll of delta at pos.

methods.name: Post
methods.synopsis: Post queues fn to run on the UI executor at the beginning of the next App.Update.

methods.name: Root
methods.synopsis: Root returns the reference to the root node, which is the component instance mounted from Options.Root.

methods.name: ScrollBy
methods.synopsis: ScrollBy moves the scroll container r by d document units and reports whether the offset changed.

methods.name: ScrollInfo
methods.synopsis: ScrollInfo returns the state of the scroll container r, and false when r is stale or is not a scroll container.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.synopsis: ScrollIntoView adjusts every scroll container above r so that r is inside the visible part of each of them, and reports whether anything moved.

methods.name: ScrollTo
methods.synopsis: ScrollTo moves the scroll container r to the document offset off, clamped to its bounds, and reports whether the offset changed.

methods.name: SetDensity
methods.synopsis: SetDensity sets the device density, that is how many physical pixels one logical pixel of the layout covers along each axis.

methods.name: SetImages
methods.synopsis: SetImages installs the image resource service a painter reaches through PaintContext.Images.

methods.name: SetModifiers
methods.synopsis: SetModifiers records which modifier keys are currently held.

methods.name: SoftKeyboardRequested
methods.synopsis: SoftKeyboardRequested reports whether the focused node asked for an on-screen keyboard; see EventContext.RequestSoftKeyboard.

methods.name: TypeRune
methods.synopsis: TypeRune reports one character the user typed, as the platform's keyboard layout produced it.

methods.name: Update
methods.synopsis: Update runs build, reconciliation and layout.

methods.name: Viewport
methods.synopsis: Viewport returns the logical size the application was last laid out at, that is the size handed to the most recent App.Update.

Binding.synopsis: Binding connects reading and writing of one state for a control, without giving the control ownership of the state.

methods.name: Get
methods.synopsis: Get returns the current value.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether the binding is the unusable zero value.

methods.name: Set
methods.synopsis: Set stores v, with the same semantics as State.Set.

methods.name: SoftKeyboardRequested
methods.synopsis: SoftKeyboardRequested reports whether the focused node asked for an on-screen keyboard.

Context.synopsis: Context is the interface of a component function to the runtime.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key returns the key this component instance was mounted under.

methods.name: Path
methods.synopsis: Path returns the slash separated path of component keys from the root to this component instance.

methods.name: Read
methods.synopsis: Read returns the current value of s and registers the state as a dependency of the component instance currently being built.

methods.name: Request
methods.synopsis: Request starts a new asynchronous request for this component instance and returns the Token that identifies it.

methods.name: State
methods.synopsis: State returns the typed state with the given name, creating it with the value initial on first use.

ControlState.synopsis: ControlState is the retained presentation state of one control: the gesture it is in the middle of, and the animation it is in the middle of.
ControlState.decl:
type ControlState struct {
	Grabbed bool
	Grab    float32
	Target  float32
	From    float32
	Start   time.Duration
	At      geom.Point
	Armed   bool
}

Diagnostics.synopsis: Diagnostics is a snapshot of the frame path counters.
Diagnostics.decl:
type Diagnostics struct {
	Frames           uint64
	Updates          uint64
	Builds           uint64
	Layouts          uint64
	PaintedNodes     uint64
	PaintedOps       uint64
	LiveNodes        uint64
	LiveScopes       uint64
	OverflowNodes    uint64
	HitTests         uint64
	InputEvents      uint64
	Scrolls          uint64
	DiscardedTouches uint64
	RunesTyped       uint64
	KeyRepeats       uint64
	Animations       uint64
	Animating        bool
	OverflowExtent   float32
}

Element.synopsis: Element is the description of one retained node.
Element.decl:
type Element struct {
	Key            string
	Label          string
	Layouter       Layouter
	Painter        Painter
	Children       []View
	Flex           float32
	Interactor     Interactor
	Focusable      bool
	Disabled       bool
	Obstructs      bool
	Clip           bool
	Transform      *geom.Affine2D
	Scroll         *ScrollSpec
	Hidden         bool
	Layer          bool
	FocusTrap      bool
	Transition     TransitionSpec
	KeyFallback    bool
	PreservesFocus bool
}

Event.synopsis: Event is one input event as an Interactor sees it.
Event.decl:
type Event struct {
	Kind    EventKind
	Pointer PointerID
	Device  PointerKind
	Pos     geom.Point
	Delta   geom.Point
	Inside  bool
	Dragged bool
	Key     Key
	Mods    Mods
	Rune    rune
	Repeat  bool
	Time    time.Duration
}

methods.name: IsPointer
methods.synopsis: IsPointer reports whether e is a pointer event, that is one with a meaningful Pos.

EventContext.synopsis: EventContext is the interface of an Interactor to the runtime.

methods.name: Animate
methods.synopsis: Animate keeps the receiving node marked for repaint for the next d, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: Bounds
methods.synopsis: Bounds returns the absolute rectangle of the receiving node, as computed by the last layout pass.

methods.name: ClearFocus
methods.synopsis: ClearFocus removes the keyboard focus from whatever holds it.

methods.name: ControlState
methods.synopsis: ControlState returns the control state of the node receiving the event.

methods.name: DeviceBounds
methods.synopsis: DeviceBounds returns the rectangle of the receiving node mapped through the transforms of its ancestors, which is the space Event.Pos lives in.

methods.name: DismissSoftKeyboard
methods.synopsis: DismissSoftKeyboard puts the on-screen keyboard away from inside an event handler, by blurring whatever asked for it, and reports whether there was one up.

methods.name: Interaction
methods.synopsis: Interaction returns the hover, press, focus and disabled state gift maintains for the receiving node.

methods.name: KeyDown
methods.synopsis: KeyDown injects a key press, as App.KeyDown does for the backend.

methods.name: KeyUp
methods.synopsis: KeyUp injects a key release; see EventContext.KeyDown.

methods.name: Now
methods.synopsis: Now returns the timestamp of the event being dispatched, on the clock App.BeginInput is given: the clock a control's animation is started on.

methods.name: Repaint
methods.synopsis: Repaint marks the receiving node as needing to be drawn again, without rebuilding or re measuring anything.

methods.name: RequestFocus
methods.synopsis: RequestFocus moves the keyboard focus to the receiving node, if it declared itself focusable.

methods.name: RequestLayout
methods.synopsis: RequestLayout marks the receiving node as needing another layout pass in the next update, without rebuilding anything.

methods.name: RequestSoftKeyboard
methods.synopsis: RequestSoftKeyboard declares whether the receiving node wants an on-screen keyboard, and asks for a rebuild when the answer changed.

methods.name: ScrollBy
methods.synopsis: ScrollBy moves the scroll container receiving the event by d document units and reports whether the offset changed; see EventContext.ScrollTo.

methods.name: ScrollIndicator
methods.synopsis: ScrollIndicator returns the indicator state of the scroll container receiving the event, and false when this node is not one.

methods.name: ScrollInfo
methods.synopsis: ScrollInfo returns the state of the scroll container receiving the event, and false when this node is not one.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.synopsis: ScrollIntoView adjusts every scroll container above the receiving node so that the node is visible, and reports whether anything moved.

methods.name: ScrollTo
methods.synopsis: ScrollTo moves the scroll container receiving the event to the document offset off, clamped, and reports whether the offset changed.

methods.name: SetControlState
methods.synopsis: SetControlState writes the control state of the node receiving the event and marks it for repaint when it changed.

methods.name: SetScrollIndicator
methods.synopsis: SetScrollIndicator writes the indicator state of the scroll container receiving the event and reports whether it changed.

methods.name: StealPointer
methods.synopsis: StealPointer moves the capture of the pointer whose event is being dispatched to the receiving node, and reports whether the node holds it afterwards.

methods.name: TypeRune
methods.synopsis: TypeRune injects one character as though the platform's keyboard had produced it.

Interaction.synopsis: Interaction is the presentation state gift maintains for an interactive node.
Interaction.decl:
type Interaction struct {
	Hover        bool
	Pressed      bool
	Focused      bool
	FocusVisible bool
	Disabled     bool
}

Interactor.synopsis: Interactor is the retained half of a view that wants input.

constructors.name: ScrollInteractor
constructors.synopsis: ScrollInteractor returns the Interactor gift installs on a scroll container that brought none of its own: wheel, drag past DragSlop and the kinetic fling, with the overscroll chaining rule described on it.

Key.synopsis: Key is a physical key, in the small set gift's own navigation, activation and text editing need.

LayoutContext.synopsis: LayoutContext gives a Layouter access to its children.

methods.name: AnchorScroll
methods.synopsis: AnchorScroll pins this scroll container's viewport to the document coordinate off, clamped to the content reported so far, and reports whether the offset changed.

methods.name: Animate
methods.synopsis: Animate keeps the node being laid out marked for repaint for the next d, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: ChildBaseline
methods.synopsis: ChildBaseline returns the baseline the given child reported during this layout pass, and whether it reported one at all.

methods.name: ChildCount
methods.synopsis: ChildCount returns the number of children of the node being laid out.

methods.name: ChildFlex
methods.synopsis: ChildFlex returns Element.Flex of the given child, zero for an inflexible one.

methods.name: ChildSize
methods.synopsis: ChildSize returns the size a child chose in a preceding LayoutContext.Measure.

methods.name: ControlState
methods.synopsis: ControlState returns the control state of the node being laid out.

methods.name: Density
methods.synopsis: Density returns the device density, that is how many physical pixels one logical pixel covers.

methods.name: Invalidator
methods.synopsis: Invalidator returns a function that marks this node for layout from outside the frame, and nil for a node that is no longer part of the tree.

methods.name: Measure
methods.synopsis: Measure lays out the given child with the constraints c and returns the size the child chose.

methods.name: Node
methods.synopsis: Node returns a reference to the node being laid out.

methods.name: Now
methods.synopsis: Now returns the timestamp of the input phase this layout pass belongs to, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: OffScreen
methods.synopsis: OffScreen reports whether the node being laid out is inside a subtree that declared Element.Hidden.

methods.name: Pass
methods.synopsis: Pass returns the ordinal of the layout pass this call belongs to.

methods.name: Place
methods.synopsis: Place positions the given child at the offset at, relative to the origin of the node being laid out.

methods.name: ReportBaseline
methods.synopsis: ReportBaseline records the distance from the top of this node to the baseline its content sits on, in logical pixels.

methods.name: ReportOverflow
methods.synopsis: ReportOverflow records that this node's content did not fit into the size it reported, by over logical pixels per axis.

methods.name: ReportScrollContent
methods.synopsis: ReportScrollContent tells gift how far the content of this scroll container reaches and where local coordinate zero sits in the document.

methods.name: RequestBuild
methods.synopsis: RequestBuild asks gift to rebuild the component instance that produced this node, in the next update.

methods.name: RequestLayout
methods.synopsis: RequestLayout asks for another layout pass over this node in the next update, without rebuilding anything.

methods.name: ScrollOffset
methods.synopsis: ScrollOffset returns the current offset of this scroll container, for a layouter that virtualises its content and therefore has to know which part of the document it is being asked to produce.

methods.name: SetChildLabel
methods.synopsis: SetChildLabel replaces Element.Label of the given child until that child is built again.

methods.name: SetControlState
methods.synopsis: SetControlState writes the control state of the node being laid out.

Layouter.synopsis: Layouter measures a node and places its children.

Mods.synopsis: Mods is the set of modifier keys held while an event happened.

methods.name: Has
methods.synopsis: Has reports whether every modifier in m is set in s.

NodeRef.synopsis: NodeRef refers to one node of the retained tree.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether r refers to no node.

PaintContext.synopsis: PaintContext is the interface of a Painter to the display list.

methods.name: Add
methods.synopsis: Add appends op to the display list.

methods.name: AddMaterial
methods.synopsis: AddMaterial appends a material to the side table of the display list and returns its index, for render.Op.Material.

methods.name: Animate
methods.synopsis: Animate keeps the node being painted marked for repaint for the next d.

methods.name: AppendGlyph
methods.synopsis: AppendGlyph appends one positioned glyph to the display list.

methods.name: Bounds
methods.synopsis: Bounds returns the absolute rectangle of the node being painted, as computed by the last layout pass.

methods.name: ChildCount
methods.synopsis: ChildCount returns the number of children of the node being painted.

methods.name: ControlState
methods.synopsis: ControlState returns the control state of the node being painted.

methods.name: DeviceBounds
methods.synopsis: DeviceBounds returns the rectangle of the node being painted mapped through the transform that is active for it, which is the space clips live in.

methods.name: GlyphsLen
methods.synopsis: GlyphsLen returns the current length of the glyph side table of the display list, which is the index the next PaintContext.AppendGlyph writes to.

methods.name: Images
methods.synopsis: Images returns the backend's image resource service, or nil when there is none.

methods.name: Interaction
methods.synopsis: Interaction returns the hover, press, focus and disabled state gift maintains for the node being painted.

methods.name: Now
methods.synopsis: Now returns the timestamp of the input phase this frame was drawn after, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: PaintChild
methods.synopsis: PaintChild paints the child with the given index.

methods.name: PaintChildren
methods.synopsis: PaintChildren paints all children of the current node, in order.

methods.name: PopClip
methods.synopsis: PopClip removes the innermost clip pushed by this painter.

methods.name: PopTransform
methods.synopsis: PopTransform ends the innermost PaintContext.PushTransform of this painter.

methods.name: PushClip
methods.synopsis: PushClip intersects r, which is in device space, with the active clip and makes the result active for all following operations until the matching PaintContext.PopClip.

methods.name: PushTransform
methods.synopsis: PushTransform applies m to everything this painter adds from now on and to the children it paints, until the matching PaintContext.PopTransform.

methods.name: ScrollIndicator
methods.synopsis: ScrollIndicator returns the indicator state of the scroll container being painted, and false when this node is not one.

methods.name: ScrollInfo
methods.synopsis: ScrollInfo returns the state of the scroll container being painted, and false when this node is not one.

methods.name: TransitionPhase
methods.synopsis: TransitionPhase returns how far the subtree being painted is through a transition: 0 at rest, 1 fully parked.

Painter.synopsis: Painter emits the drawing operations of one node.

PointerKind.synopsis: PointerKind tells a mouse from a finger.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String returns "mouse" or "touch".

ScrollAxis.synopsis: ScrollAxis is the single axis a scroll container moves along.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String returns "none", "vertical" or "horizontal".

ScrollConfig.synopsis: ScrollConfig tunes the gesture behaviour of one scroll container.
ScrollConfig.decl:
type ScrollConfig struct {
	Friction      float32
	FlingVelocity float32
	StopVelocity  float32
	MaxVelocity   float32
	WheelStep     float32
	HardStop      bool
}

ScrollIndicatorState.synopsis: ScrollIndicatorState is the presentation state of the decoration that draws a scroll container's position — the grab of its thumb and the hover of its track.

methods.name: Active
methods.synopsis: Active reports whether the indicator is engaged by the pointer in either sense.

ScrollInfo.synopsis: ScrollInfo is a snapshot of the state of one scroll container.
ScrollInfo.decl:
type ScrollInfo struct {
	Axis           ScrollAxis
	Offset         float64
	MaxOffset      float64
	ContentExtent  float64
	ContentOrigin  float64
	ViewportExtent float32
	Velocity       float32
	Flinging       bool
	Dragging       bool
	Virtual        bool
	IdleFor        time.Duration
}

ScrollSpec.synopsis: ScrollSpec declares a node to be a scroll viewport.

State.synopsis: State is a typed, observable value owned by one component instance.

methods.name: Binding
methods.synopsis: Binding returns a read/write handle to this state.

methods.name: Get
methods.synopsis: Get returns the current value without registering a dependency.

methods.name: Set
methods.synopsis: Set stores v and invalidates every scope that read this state in its last build.

Token.synopsis: Token identifies one asynchronous request of one component instance.

methods.name: Post
methods.synopsis: Post hands fn to the UI executor, like App.Post, and runs it there only if the token is still Token.Valid by then: the result of a request that was replaced, or whose component was unmounted, is dropped.

methods.name: Valid
methods.synopsis: Valid reports whether the result of this request may still be applied: the component instance is still mounted and no newer request has been started on it.

TransitionSpec.synopsis: TransitionSpec declares where a node sits while it is hidden, so that Element.Hidden becomes a movement instead of a cut.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether the spec asks for no movement at all.

TypeID.synopsis: TypeID is a process wide stable identifier of a concrete view type.

constructors.name: RegisterType
constructors.synopsis: RegisterType registers a view type under the given name and returns its TypeID.

View.synopsis: View is a short lived description of a piece of user interface.

constructors.name: Component
constructors.signature: Component(key string, fn func(*Context) View) View
constructors.synopsis: Component mounts fn as a stateful component instance with a state scope of its own.

constructors.name: Memo
constructors.signature: Memo[P comparable](key string, props P, fn func(*Context, P) View) View
constructors.synopsis: Memo mounts a stateful component that is only rebuilt when props changes or when one of its own state dependencies fires.

funcs.name: RegisteredTypeNames
funcs.synopsis: RegisteredTypeNames appends the names of every registered view type to dst and returns the extended slice.

funcs.name: RoundDensity
funcs.synopsis: RoundDensity turns a raw device scale factor into the integer density gift works in.

funcs.name: TypeName
funcs.synopsis: TypeName returns the name a type was registered under, or a placeholder for an unknown ID.

gifttest.synopsis: Package gifttest drives a gift application from a Go test.

Harness.synopsis: Harness is one application under test: the gift.App, the injected clock and the viewport.

constructors.name: New
constructors.synopsis: New mounts the view and brings it to a settled, painted steady state.

methods.name: Advance
methods.synopsis: Advance moves the injected clock forward by d and settles.

methods.name: AdvanceTicks
methods.synopsis: AdvanceTicks moves the injected clock forward n times by step, opening an input phase and settling at each stop.

methods.name: App
methods.synopsis: App returns the application under test, for the cases this package has no verb for.

methods.name: AssertCount
methods.synopsis: AssertCount fails unless exactly want nodes match s, listing the ones that did.

methods.name: AssertExists
methods.synopsis: AssertExists fails when nothing matches s.

methods.name: AssertFocus
methods.synopsis: AssertFocus fails unless the focused node matches s.

methods.name: AssertGolden
methods.synopsis: AssertGolden compares the rendered frame against the PNG in testdata.

methods.name: AssertNoFocus
methods.synopsis: AssertNoFocus fails when anything holds the keyboard focus.

methods.name: AssertNoOverflow
methods.synopsis: AssertNoOverflow fails when any node's content does not fit the size it reported.

methods.name: AssertNone
methods.synopsis: AssertNone fails when anything matches s, naming what did.

methods.name: AssertOpaque
methods.synopsis: AssertOpaque fails unless every pixel of the framebuffer is fully opaque.

methods.name: AssertOps
methods.signature: AssertOps(desc string, want int, pred func(render.Op) bool)
methods.synopsis: AssertOps fails unless exactly want operations of the most recent frame satisfy pred.

methods.name: AssertPixel
methods.synopsis: AssertPixel fails unless the pixel at p is want, within GoldenTolerance.

methods.name: At
methods.synopsis: At returns the topmost interactive node at the device space point p.

methods.name: CancelPointer
methods.synopsis: CancelPointer ends the current mouse press without a release, as the window manager does when the window loses focus.

methods.name: CancelTouch
methods.synopsis: CancelTouch ends the current touch without a release.

methods.name: ClickAt
methods.synopsis: ClickAt clicks at a device space point.

methods.name: Density
methods.synopsis: Density returns the device density in force, after the rounding of gift.RoundDensity.

methods.name: Diagnostics
methods.synopsis: Diagnostics returns the counter snapshot of the application, for the tests whose subject is the frame path itself — "this hover rebuilt nothing" is an assertion about gift.Diagnostics.Builds.

methods.name: Dump
methods.synopsis: Dump returns the retained tree as indented text: type, key, label, bounds and the input flags of every node.

methods.name: Exists
methods.synopsis: Exists reports whether at least one node matches s, without failing.

methods.name: Find
methods.synopsis: Find returns the single node matching s and fails the test when there is not exactly one.

methods.name: FindAll
methods.synopsis: FindAll returns every node matching s, in document order.

methods.name: First
methods.synopsis: First returns the first node matching s in document order and fails when there is none.

methods.name: Focused
methods.synopsis: Focused returns the node that currently holds the keyboard focus, and whether anything does.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame advances exactly one frame: input phase, update, paint.

methods.name: Image
methods.synopsis: Image renders the current frame and returns it.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key presses and releases one key, with the given modifiers held.

methods.name: KeyDown
methods.synopsis: KeyDown presses a key and leaves it down.

methods.name: KeyUp
methods.synopsis: KeyUp releases a key.

methods.name: List
methods.synopsis: List returns the borrowed display list of the most recent frame, for the assertions that need the clip and transform side tables — render.List.Clip and render.List.Glyphs are only meaningful against the list they came from.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.synopsis: MoveTo moves the mouse to the device space point p.

methods.name: Now
methods.synopsis: Now returns the value of the injected clock, as a duration since an arbitrary origin.

methods.name: Ops
methods.synopsis: Ops returns a copy of the display list of the most recent frame.

methods.name: PressAt
methods.synopsis: PressAt presses the mouse at p.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release releases the mouse wherever it currently is.

methods.name: ReleaseAt
methods.synopsis: ReleaseAt releases the mouse at p.

methods.name: Resize
methods.synopsis: Resize changes the viewport and settles.

methods.name: SetModifiers
methods.synopsis: SetModifiers records which modifier keys are held from now on.

methods.name: Settle
methods.synopsis: Settle pumps frames until the application stops changing, and fails if it never does.

methods.name: ShiftTab
methods.synopsis: ShiftTab moves the keyboard focus to the previous focusable node.

methods.name: Size
methods.synopsis: Size returns the current viewport.

methods.name: Tab
methods.synopsis: Tab moves the keyboard focus to the next focusable node, by actually pressing tab.

methods.name: TapAt
methods.synopsis: TapAt is a touch at a device space point: a finger goes down there and comes straight up again.

methods.name: TouchDownAt
methods.synopsis: TouchDownAt puts a finger down at the device space point p and leaves it there.

methods.name: TouchMoveTo
methods.synopsis: TouchMoveTo moves the finger that is down to p.

methods.name: TouchUpAt
methods.synopsis: TouchUpAt lifts the finger at p.

methods.name: TypeRune
methods.synopsis: TypeRune types a single character.

methods.name: TypeText
methods.synopsis: TypeText types the string, one character at a time, as a keyboard with the user's layout would deliver it.

methods.name: Warm
methods.synopsis: Warm is a no-op in a build without a graphics context.

methods.name: Wheel
methods.synopsis: Wheel scrolls at the device space point p by d.

Node.synopsis: Node is one node of the retained tree, as a test refers to it.

methods.name: AssertAtScrollEnd
methods.synopsis: AssertAtScrollEnd fails unless the container is at its maximum offset.

methods.name: AssertAtScrollStart
methods.synopsis: AssertAtScrollStart fails unless the container is at offset zero.

methods.name: AssertBackground
methods.synopsis: AssertBackground fails unless the node fills its shape with want.

methods.name: AssertBounds
methods.synopsis: AssertBounds fails unless the node's rectangle equals want within [boundsTolerance], reporting the difference per edge.

methods.name: AssertDisabled
methods.synopsis: AssertDisabled fails when the node is not disabled.

methods.name: AssertDrawsGlyphs
methods.synopsis: AssertDrawsGlyphs fails when the node's bounds contain no glyph in the most recent frame.

methods.name: AssertDrawsImage
methods.synopsis: AssertDrawsImage fails when the node draws no picture in the most recent frame.

methods.name: AssertEnabled
methods.synopsis: AssertEnabled fails when the node is disabled.

methods.name: AssertFocused
methods.synopsis: AssertFocused fails when the node does not hold the keyboard focus.

methods.name: AssertGlassQuality
methods.synopsis: AssertGlassQuality fails unless the node's glass material requested want.

methods.name: AssertHovered
methods.synopsis: AssertHovered fails when no mouse is over the node.

methods.name: AssertKey
methods.synopsis: AssertKey fails unless the node's reconciliation key is want.

methods.name: AssertMaterial
methods.synopsis: AssertMaterial fails unless the node paints a material of kind want.

methods.name: AssertNotFocused
methods.synopsis: AssertNotFocused fails when the node holds the keyboard focus.

methods.name: AssertNotHovered
methods.synopsis: AssertNotHovered fails when the node is hovered.

methods.name: AssertNotPressed
methods.synopsis: AssertNotPressed fails when the node is pressed.

methods.name: AssertNotVisible
methods.synopsis: AssertNotVisible fails when any part of the node survives the clips above it.

methods.name: AssertPaints
methods.synopsis: AssertPaints fails unless at least one operation of the most recent frame is of kind k, covers the node and is drawn in colour c.

methods.name: AssertPressed
methods.synopsis: AssertPressed fails when the node is not pressed.

methods.name: AssertScrollOffset
methods.synopsis: AssertScrollOffset fails unless the nearest scroll container at or above the node sits at the document offset want, within [boundsTolerance].

methods.name: AssertSize
methods.synopsis: AssertSize fails unless the node's size equals want within [boundsTolerance].

methods.name: AssertText
methods.synopsis: AssertText fails unless the node's label is exactly want.

methods.name: AssertType
methods.synopsis: AssertType fails unless the node was built from the view type registered under want, such as "ui.Button".

methods.name: AssertVisible
methods.synopsis: AssertVisible fails when the node is entirely clipped away by an ancestor, naming the clip that removed it.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background returns the colour the node fills its shape with in the most recent frame, and whether it fills one at all.

methods.name: Bounds
methods.synopsis: Bounds returns the rectangle of the node in device space: where it actually is on screen, after the scroll offsets and transforms above it.

methods.name: Center
methods.synopsis: Center returns the point the pointer actions aim at: the middle of the *visible* part of the node.

methods.name: Children
methods.synopsis: Children returns the children of the node, in order.

methods.name: Click
methods.synopsis: Click moves the mouse onto the node, presses and releases it.

methods.name: Describe
methods.synopsis: Describe returns the one line form of the node used in failure messages: type, key, label and device bounds.

methods.name: Drag
methods.synopsis: Drag presses the mouse on this node, moves it to the centre of dst in several steps and releases it there.

methods.name: DragTo
methods.synopsis: DragTo presses the mouse on this node, moves it to the device space point p in several steps and releases it there.

methods.name: Find
methods.synopsis: Find returns the single node in this node's subtree, including itself, that matches s, and fails when there is not exactly one.

methods.name: Fling
methods.synopsis: Fling is a touch drag along d that takes over milliseconds of the injected clock, so that gift can measure a release velocity and start a kinetic scroll.

methods.name: Focus
methods.synopsis: Focus moves the keyboard focus to this node and fails when it cannot take it, which is the honest answer for a disabled or non focusable node.

methods.name: Glass
methods.synopsis: Glass returns the glass parameters of the node's material and fails when it has none.

methods.name: Glyphs
methods.synopsis: Glyphs returns the glyphs of the most recent frame that lie inside the node's bounds, which is how a headless test says "something was actually drawn here" for text.

methods.name: Hover
methods.synopsis: Hover moves the mouse onto the node without pressing.

methods.name: Interaction
methods.synopsis: Interaction returns the hover, press, focus and disabled state gift keeps for the node.

methods.name: IsVisible
methods.synopsis: IsVisible reports whether any part of the node survives the clips above it.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether n refers to no node at all.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key returns the reconciliation key of the node, or "".

methods.name: LayoutBounds
methods.synopsis: LayoutBounds returns the rectangle the layout gave the node, without the transforms of its ancestors.

methods.name: LongPress
methods.synopsis: LongPress puts a finger on the node, holds it past gift.LongPressDelay and lifts it.

methods.name: Material
methods.synopsis: Material returns the backdrop dependent background of the node in the most recent frame, and whether it has one.

methods.name: Parent
methods.synopsis: Parent returns the parent node.

methods.name: Press
methods.synopsis: Press moves the mouse onto the node and presses the button, leaving it down.

methods.name: PressKey
methods.synopsis: PressKey focuses the node and sends one key press and release to it.

methods.name: Ref
methods.synopsis: Ref returns the underlying gift.NodeRef, for the escape hatch through Harness.App.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release releases the mouse button over this node.

methods.name: ScrollBy
methods.synopsis: ScrollBy moves the nearest scroll container at or above this node by d document units.

methods.name: ScrollInfo
methods.synopsis: ScrollInfo returns the full state of the nearest scroll container at or above this node.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.synopsis: ScrollIntoView scrolls every container above this node until it is visible.

methods.name: ScrollOffset
methods.synopsis: ScrollOffset returns the document offset of the nearest scroll container at or above this node.

methods.name: ScrollTo
methods.synopsis: ScrollTo moves the nearest scroll container at or above this node to the document offset off, clamped to its bounds.

methods.name: Scroller
methods.synopsis: Scroller returns the nearest scroll container at or above this node, and fails when there is none.

methods.name: Swipe
methods.synopsis: Swipe is a drag with a finger: down on this node, along d, up.

methods.name: Tap
methods.synopsis: Tap is a touch: a finger goes down on the node and comes straight up again.

methods.name: Text
methods.synopsis: Text returns gift.Element.Label of the node, which is what ByText matches against.

methods.name: Type
methods.synopsis: Type returns the registered name of the view type the node was built from, such as "ui.Button".

methods.name: VisibleBounds
methods.synopsis: VisibleBounds returns the part of the node that survives the clips of its ancestors, and whether any of it does.

methods.name: Wheel
methods.synopsis: Wheel scrolls over the node by d.

Options.decl:
type Options struct {
	Root      func(*gift.Context) gift.View
	View      gift.View
	Size      geom.Size
	Logger    *slog.Logger
	MaxFrames int
	Density   float64
	Theme     ui.Theme
	Font      ui.Font
}

Selector.synopsis: Selector is a predicate over the nodes of the retained tree.

constructors.name: Any
constructors.synopsis: Any matches every node in the tree.

constructors.name: ByKey
constructors.synopsis: ByKey matches a node whose reconciliation key is k.

constructors.name: ByText
constructors.synopsis: ByText matches a node whose label is exactly s.

constructors.name: ByTextContains
constructors.synopsis: ByTextContains matches a node whose label contains sub.

constructors.name: ByType
constructors.synopsis: ByType matches a node built from the view type registered under name, such as "ui.Button" or "ui.Text".

constructors.name: Enabled
constructors.synopsis: Enabled matches a node that is not disabled.

constructors.name: Focusable
constructors.synopsis: Focusable matches a node that could currently take the keyboard focus.

constructors.name: Interactive
constructors.synopsis: Interactive matches a node that takes part in hit testing, that is one whose element carried a gift.Interactor.

constructors.name: Not
constructors.synopsis: Not inverts a selector.

constructors.name: Under
constructors.synopsis: Under matches a node that is a descendant of some node matching parent.

constructors.name: Visible
constructors.synopsis: Visible matches a node that is actually on the screen: not inside a subtree that declared gift.Element.Hidden, and not entirely clipped away by an ancestor.

constructors.name: Where
constructors.signature: Where(desc string, pred func(Node) bool) Selector
constructors.synopsis: Where builds a selector from an arbitrary predicate over a Node.

methods.name: And
methods.synopsis: And matches when both selectors match the same node.

methods.name: Or
methods.synopsis: Or matches when either selector matches the node.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String returns the human readable form of the selector, as it appears in a failure message.

TB.synopsis: TB is the part of testing.TB this package uses.

funcs.name: Main
funcs.synopsis: Main is the TestMain a package with golden tests installs:

funcs.name: Update
funcs.synopsis: Update reports whether goldens are being rewritten, that is whether GIFT_UPDATE_GOLDEN is set to something other than "0" or "".

ui.synopsis: Package ui is the public view layer of gift.

AlertButton.synopsis: AlertButton is one choice in an AlertView.

constructors.name: AlertAction
constructors.synopsis: AlertAction is the ordinary choice of an alert, drawn in ColorAccent.

constructors.name: AlertCancel
constructors.synopsis: AlertCancel is the choice that backs out, drawn in ColorLabel.

constructors.name: AlertDestructive
constructors.synopsis: AlertDestructive is the choice that destroys something, drawn in ColorDanger.

AlertView.synopsis: AlertView is a card with a title, a message and a row of choices, meant to be handed to Modal.

constructors.name: Alert
constructors.synopsis: Alert returns an alert card.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the alert take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

Background.synopsis: Background is what a view fills its shape with: a Color or a material.

BadgeView.synopsis: BadgeView is a small capsule with a short string in it: a count, a status, a unit.

constructors.name: Badge
constructors.synopsis: Badge returns a badge showing text.

methods.name: Color
methods.synopsis: Color sets the capsule fill, replacing ColorAccent.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the badge take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Foreground
methods.synopsis: Foreground sets the text colour, replacing ColorOnAccent.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

Border.synopsis: Border is a stroke along the inside of the bounds of a view.

BoxView.synopsis: BoxView is a styled rectangle without children.

constructors.name: Box
constructors.synopsis: Box returns an unstyled, zero sized rectangle.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background fills the bounds.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border strokes the inside of the bounds.

methods.name: Clip
methods.synopsis: Clip confines the node's children to its full bounds; see gift.Element.Clip.

methods.name: CornerRadius
methods.synopsis: CornerRadius rounds the background and the border.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the box take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, proportional to v.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: MaxHeight
methods.synopsis: MaxHeight lowers the maximum height of the node, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the node, and the minimum with it if that is higher.

methods.name: MinHeight
methods.synopsis: MinHeight raises the minimum height of the node, and the maximum with it if that is lower; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth raises the minimum width of the node.

methods.name: Padding
methods.synopsis: Padding sets the same padding on all four edges, replacing any previous padding.

methods.name: PaddingInsets
methods.synopsis: PaddingInsets sets the padding per edge, replacing any previous padding.

methods.name: Shadow
methods.synopsis: Shadow draws a blurred copy of the box's shape — its bounds, rounded by BoxView.CornerRadius — behind the view.

ButtonStyle.synopsis: ButtonStyle is the appearance of a button's own box in one interaction state.

ButtonView.synopsis: ButtonView is a pressable control around an arbitrary label view.

constructors.name: Button
constructors.synopsis: Button returns a button showing label and calling action when it is activated.

methods.name: Align
methods.synopsis: Align sets where the label sits inside the padded bounds.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background fills the bounds in the normal state.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border strokes the inside of the bounds in the normal state.

methods.name: Clip
methods.synopsis: Clip confines the label to the bounds, for paint and for hit testing alike.

methods.name: CornerRadius
methods.synopsis: CornerRadius rounds the background and the border in every state that does not override it.

methods.name: Disabled
methods.synopsis: Disabled takes the button out of input.

methods.name: DisabledStyle
methods.synopsis: DisabledStyle sets the look while the button is disabled.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the button take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, proportional to v.

methods.name: FocusRing
methods.synopsis: FocusRing sets the border drawn on top of the button while it holds the keyboard focus.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes.

methods.name: HoverStyle
methods.synopsis: HoverStyle sets the look while a mouse is over the button.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name of the button, the string a person would use to refer to the command.

methods.name: Lift
methods.synopsis: Lift gives the button the press feedback of iOS 26: it grows by a few percent while pressed, lights up under the finger, and springs back on release.

methods.name: MaxHeight
methods.synopsis: MaxHeight lowers the maximum height of the button, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the button, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinHeight
methods.synopsis: MinHeight raises the minimum height of the button, and the maximum with it if that is lower; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth raises the minimum width of the button, and the maximum with it if that is lower; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: Padding
methods.synopsis: Padding sets the same padding on all four edges around the label, replacing any previous padding and the default of 6 by 12.

methods.name: PaddingInsets
methods.synopsis: PaddingInsets sets the padding per edge, replacing any previous padding.

methods.name: PressedStyle
methods.synopsis: PressedStyle sets the look while a pointer this button captured is down and inside it.

methods.name: Shadow
methods.synopsis: Shadow draws a blurred copy of the button's box behind it.

methods.name: Style
methods.synopsis: Style sets the normal state box style in one call.

CardView.synopsis: CardView is a panel raised above the window background: a ColorSurface face, a corner radius, a hairline and an optional header.

constructors.name: Card
constructors.synopsis: Card returns a card holding children, stacked vertically.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the card take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Gap
methods.synopsis: Gap sets the space between two adjacent children, replacing the default.

methods.name: Header
methods.synopsis: Header sets the caption drawn above the content, in ColorSecondaryLabel.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Padding
methods.synopsis: Padding sets the inset of the card's content on all four edges, replacing the default of CardPadding.

methods.name: PaddingInsets
methods.synopsis: PaddingInsets sets the inset of the card's content per edge, replacing the default.

CheckedClipboard.synopsis: CheckedClipboard is the optional extension of Clipboard for a write whose failure the caller has to know about.

Clipboard.synopsis: Clipboard is the system clipboard as the text views of this package use it.

constructors.name: CurrentClipboard
constructors.synopsis: CurrentClipboard returns the installed clipboard, or the in-process default.

Color.synopsis: Color is the colour type of gift.

constructors.name: Fade
constructors.synopsis: Fade returns c at f times its opacity, where f is between 0 and 1.

constructors.name: RGB
constructors.synopsis: RGB returns the fully opaque Color for the given 8 bit components.

constructors.name: RGBA
constructors.signature: RGBA(r, g, b, a uint8) Color
constructors.synopsis: RGBA returns the Color for the given straight alpha 8 bit components.

constructors.name: ResolveColor
constructors.synopsis: ResolveColor turns a semantic colour into the literal colour of the theme in force.

constructors.name: Divider
constructors.synopsis: Divider returns a hairline of DividerThickness in ColorSeparator.

methods.name: Color
methods.synopsis: Color sets the colour of the line, replacing ColorSeparator.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the divider take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Inset
methods.synopsis: Inset shortens the line at its leading and trailing ends, in logical pixels.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Thickness
methods.synopsis: Thickness sets the height of the line in logical pixels.

Font.synopsis: Font is a loaded font, ready to shape and to rasterise with.

constructors.name: DefaultFont
constructors.synopsis: DefaultFont returns the font installed by SetDefaultFont, or the zero Font.

constructors.name: LoadFont
constructors.synopsis: LoadFont parses a TrueType or OpenType font, bare or wrapped in WOFF 1.

constructors.name: MustFont
constructors.synopsis: MustFont is ResolveFont for the case where the caller has just imported the package that registers the face, and a miss is therefore a programming error rather than a condition to handle.

constructors.name: ResolveFont
constructors.synopsis: ResolveFont returns the registered face that best matches q.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether f is the zero Font, that is no font at all.

FontFace.synopsis: FontFace is one registered face: what it was registered as, and the font itself.

constructors.name: RegisteredFonts
constructors.synopsis: RegisteredFonts appends every registered face to dst and returns the extended slice, sorted by family, then style, then weight.

FontQuery.synopsis: FontQuery names a face in the font register: a family, a weight and a style.

FontStyle.synopsis: FontStyle distinguishes an upright face from an italic one.

FontWeight.synopsis: FontWeight is the visual thickness of a typeface on the usual 100..900 scale, where 400 is the upright text weight and 700 is the bold one.

Gallery.synopsis: Gallery is the retained model of a virtualised image gallery: the catalogue, the selection, the spatial index and the pool of recycled tiles.

constructors.name: NewGallery
constructors.synopsis: NewGallery returns a gallery over c with an empty selection.

methods.name: Anchor
methods.signature: Anchor() (id asset.ID, local float64, ok bool)
methods.synopsis: Anchor returns the stable ID and the local offset the viewport is currently pinned to.

methods.name: ApplyCorrections
methods.synopsis: ApplyCorrections folds a batch of late arriving dimensions into the catalogue and schedules one incremental reflow for the whole batch.

methods.name: BindingOf
methods.synopsis: BindingOf returns the tile the entry with the given ID is currently in.

methods.name: Bindings
methods.synopsis: Bindings appends the current binding of every bound tile to dst and returns the extended slice, in slot order.

methods.name: Collection
methods.synopsis: Collection returns the catalogue this gallery shows.

methods.name: Columns
methods.synopsis: Columns is the masonry column count of the committed layout, and zero for a justified one.

methods.name: Compact
methods.synopsis: Compact releases the recycled scratch of the layout index.

methods.name: ContentExtent
methods.synopsis: ContentExtent is the document height of the committed layout, in logical pixels.

methods.name: Generation
methods.synopsis: Generation is the current request generation; see TileBinding.Generation.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.synopsis: Invalidate marks the gallery for another layout pass.

methods.name: ItemRect
methods.signature: ItemRect(i int) (x, y, w, h float64, ok bool)
methods.synopsis: ItemRect returns the document rectangle of catalogue entry i in the committed layout, whether or not it has a tile.

methods.name: LayoutVersion
methods.synopsis: LayoutVersion is the version of the committed layout.

methods.name: Ready
methods.synopsis: Ready reports whether a layout has been committed and the gallery has something to show.

methods.name: Reflowing
methods.synopsis: Reflowing reports whether an incremental reflow is in flight.

methods.name: Reorder
methods.synopsis: Reorder applies a new catalogue order and schedules one reflow for it.

methods.name: Reveal
methods.synopsis: Reveal asks for the entry with the given ID to be scrolled into view on the next layout pass, and reports whether the entry exists.

methods.name: Selection
methods.synopsis: Selection returns the durable selection and keyboard cursor.

methods.name: SetCollection
methods.synopsis: SetCollection replaces the catalogue.

methods.name: SetSelection
methods.synopsis: SetSelection replaces the selection object, for an application that shares one selection between two views of the same catalogue.

methods.name: SetSources
methods.synopsis: SetSources installs the resolver that turns a catalogue entry into something the image pipeline can open, and switches the gallery from placeholders to real pictures.

methods.name: SlotCount
methods.synopsis: SlotCount is the number of tile nodes that exist.

methods.name: Sources
methods.synopsis: Sources returns the resolver installed by Gallery.SetSources, or nil.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns the image side counters of this gallery.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String makes a gallery readable in a test failure.

methods.name: VisibleCount
methods.synopsis: VisibleCount is the number of entries the last layout pass found inside the viewport, before the pool size was taken into account.

GalleryLayout.synopsis: GalleryLayout is the algorithm and the metrics a gallery arranges its items with.

constructors.name: Justified
constructors.synopsis: Justified returns a layout that fills rows to the full content width, giving every item in a row the same height.

constructors.name: Spacer

methods.name: Key

Stack.synopsis: Stack is a vertical or horizontal stack of children.

constructors.name: HStack
constructors.synopsis: HStack arranges its children from leading to trailing.

constructors.name: VStack
constructors.synopsis: VStack arranges its children from top to bottom.

methods.name: Align
methods.synopsis: Align sets the cross axis alignment of the children.

methods.name: AlignBaseline
methods.synopsis: AlignBaseline lines the children up on their first text baseline instead of on an edge or the centre.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background fills the bounds behind the children.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border strokes the inside of the bounds after the children were drawn.

methods.name: Clip
methods.synopsis: Clip confines the children to the full bounds, not to the padded bounds; see gift.Element.Clip.

methods.name: CornerRadius

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the stack take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, proportional to v.

methods.name: Frame

methods.name: Gap

methods.name: Key

methods.name: MaxWidth

methods.name: MinHeight

methods.name: MinWidth

Symbol.synopsis: Symbol is one icon's geometry: pre-parsed outlines, ready to be rasterised at whatever size and density they are drawn at.

constructors.name: NewSymbol
constructors.synopsis: NewSymbol wraps encoded icon geometry produced by cmd/gift-icongen.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether s carries no geometry.

TabBarView.synopsis: TabBarView is the primary navigation of a kiosk: a row of icon-and-caption items along the bottom of the window, one screen above them.

constructors.signature: TabBar(selected int, onSelect func(int), tabs ...TabSpec) TabBarView
constructors.synopsis: TabBar returns a tab bar showing the content of tabs[selected] and calling onSelect with the index of the tab the user asked for.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the tab bar take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

TabSpec.synopsis: TabSpec is one tab: what the bar shows for it and what it contains.

constructors.name: Tab
constructors.signature: Tab(title string, sym Symbol, content gift.View) TabSpec
constructors.synopsis: Tab describes one tab of a TabBarView.

methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation identity of this tab, replacing the default of the title; see Tab.

methods.name: SelectedIcon
methods.synopsis: SelectedIcon sets the symbol drawn while this tab is the selected one.

TextAlign.synopsis: TextAlign is the horizontal alignment of the lines of a TextView inside its own width.

TextEditor.synopsis: TextEditor is the document a TextFieldView edits, together with the state of editing it: the caret, the selection anchor, the horizontal scroll of the field and the phase of the blink.

constructors.name: Editor
constructors.synopsis: Editor returns the editor named name inside the component instance ctx belongs to, creating it with initial on first use.

constructors.name: NewTextEditor
constructors.synopsis: NewTextEditor returns an editor holding s, with the caret after the last character and nothing selected.

methods.name: Caret
methods.synopsis: Caret returns the byte offset the next character would be inserted at.

methods.name: DeleteBackward
methods.synopsis: DeleteBackward removes the selection if there is one, and otherwise the rune before the caret.

methods.name: DeleteForward
methods.synopsis: DeleteForward removes the selection if there is one, and otherwise the rune after the caret.

methods.name: DeleteSelection
methods.synopsis: DeleteSelection removes the selected text and reports whether there was any.

methods.name: HasSelection
methods.synopsis: HasSelection reports whether any text is selected.

methods.name: Insert
methods.synopsis: Insert replaces the selection with s and leaves the caret after it.

methods.name: InsertRune
methods.synopsis: InsertRune is TextEditor.Insert for one character, without building a string for it.

methods.name: Len
methods.synopsis: Len returns the length of the text in bytes.

methods.name: MoveCaret
methods.synopsis: MoveCaret puts the caret at off.

methods.name: MoveEnd
methods.synopsis: MoveEnd is TextEditor.MoveHome at the other end.

methods.name: MoveHome
methods.synopsis: MoveHome and MoveEnd move the caret to the ends of the document.

methods.name: MoveLeft
methods.synopsis: MoveLeft and MoveRight move the caret by one rune.

methods.name: MoveRight
methods.synopsis: MoveRight is TextEditor.MoveLeft in the other direction.

methods.name: MoveWordLeft
methods.synopsis: MoveWordLeft and MoveWordRight move the caret to the near edge of the adjacent word; see [runeClass] for what a word is here.

methods.name: MoveWordRight
methods.synopsis: MoveWordRight is TextEditor.MoveWordLeft in the other direction.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.synopsis: SelectAll selects the whole document and leaves the caret at the end.

methods.name: SelectWordAt
methods.synopsis: SelectWordAt selects the run of text around off, where a run is what [runeClass] says it is: a word, a stretch of whitespace, or a stretch of punctuation.

methods.name: SelectedText
methods.synopsis: SelectedText returns the selected text, which is "" when nothing is selected.

methods.name: Selection
methods.synopsis: Selection returns the selected byte range as the ordered pair start, end.

methods.name: SetCaret
methods.synopsis: SetCaret moves the caret to off and clears the selection.

methods.name: SetSelection
methods.synopsis: SetSelection selects the byte range from a to b and puts the caret at b, so that a following shifted arrow extends from the end the caller named last.

methods.name: SetText
methods.synopsis: SetText replaces the whole document, puts the caret at the end and clears the selection.

methods.name: Text
methods.synopsis: Text returns the current contents.

TextFieldView.synopsis: TextFieldView is a single line text field.

constructors.name: TextField
constructors.synopsis: TextField returns a field editing ed.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background fills the bounds behind the text, replacing the themed ColorControl.

methods.name: Bind
methods.synopsis: Bind connects the field to a gift.State holding the text, in both directions: every edit writes the state, and a value written to the state from anywhere else replaces the document.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border strokes the inside of the bounds, replacing the themed hairline.

methods.name: CaretColor
methods.synopsis: CaretColor sets the colour of the caret.

methods.name: Clip
methods.synopsis: Clip is accepted only as Clip(true), which is what a field already does.

methods.name: CornerRadius
methods.synopsis: CornerRadius rounds the background and the border, replacing the default.

methods.name: Disabled
methods.synopsis: Disabled takes the field out of input: it is skipped by the focus order, receives no events, shows no caret and draws in a quieter colour on the disabled control face.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the field take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, proportional to f.

methods.name: FocusRing
methods.synopsis: FocusRing sets the border drawn on top of the field while it holds the keyboard focus.

methods.name: Font
methods.synopsis: Font sets the font the text is shaped and drawn with, overriding SetDefaultFont for this field only.

methods.name: FontSize
methods.synopsis: FontSize sets the em size in pixels.

methods.name: Foreground
methods.synopsis: Foreground sets the colour of the text.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name of the field, overriding the placeholder for that purpose.

methods.name: MaxHeight
methods.synopsis: MaxHeight lowers the maximum height of the field, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the field, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinHeight
methods.synopsis: MinHeight raises the minimum height of the field, and the maximum with it if that is lower; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth raises the minimum width of the field, and the maximum with it if that is lower; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: OnChange
methods.synopsis: OnChange registers a callback that runs after every change to the text, with the new value.

methods.name: OnSubmit
methods.synopsis: OnSubmit registers a callback that runs when the user presses enter in the field, with the current value.

methods.name: Padding
methods.synopsis: Padding sets the same padding on all four edges around the text, replacing the default of 5 by 8.

methods.name: PaddingInsets
methods.synopsis: PaddingInsets sets the padding per edge, replacing any previous padding.

methods.name: Placeholder
methods.synopsis: Placeholder sets the text shown while the field is empty, in ColorSecondaryLabel unless TextFieldView.PlaceholderColor says otherwise.

methods.name: PlaceholderColor
methods.synopsis: PlaceholderColor sets the colour of the placeholder text.

methods.name: SelectionColor
methods.synopsis: SelectionColor sets the highlight drawn behind selected text.

methods.name: Shadow
methods.synopsis: Shadow draws a blurred copy of the field's box behind it.

TextView.synopsis: TextView is a run of text.

constructors.name: Text
constructors.synopsis: Text returns a text view for s at DefaultFontSize in ColorLabel.

methods.name: Align
methods.synopsis: Align sets the horizontal alignment of the lines inside the node's width.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background fills the bounds behind the glyphs.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border strokes the inside of the bounds after the glyphs were drawn.

methods.name: Clip
methods.synopsis: Clip confines the glyphs to the bounds.

methods.name: CornerRadius
methods.synopsis: CornerRadius rounds the background and the border.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the view take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, proportional to v.

methods.name: Font
methods.synopsis: Font sets the font this view is shaped and drawn with, overriding SetDefaultFont for this view only.

methods.name: FontSize
methods.synopsis: FontSize sets the em size in pixels.

methods.name: Foreground
methods.synopsis: Foreground sets the colour the glyphs are drawn in.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: MaxHeight
methods.synopsis: MaxHeight lowers the maximum height of the node, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MaxLines

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the node, and the minimum with it if that is higher.

methods.name: MinWidth

methods.name: Padding

methods.name: PaddingInsets
methods.synopsis: PaddingInsets sets the padding per edge, replacing any previous padding.

constructors.name: LightTheme
constructors.synopsis: LightTheme returns the built in light theme.

methods.synopsis: Color returns the literal colour the theme gives to one of the named colours.

methods.name: Flex

VirtualListView.synopsis: VirtualListView is the declaration half of a virtual list.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border strokes the inside of the viewport after the rows were drawn.

methods.synopsis: Clip is accepted only as Clip(true), which is what a viewport does anyway; see GalleryView.Clip.

methods.name: Config
methods.synopsis: Config sets the gesture constants of the scroll container.

methods.name: CornerRadius
methods.synopsis: CornerRadius rounds the background and the border of the viewport.

methods.synopsis: Separators turns the hairlines between rows on, the default, or off.

methods.name: Shadow

funcs.name: ImagePipeline

funcs.name: ImagePipelineStats
funcs.synopsis: ImagePipelineStats converts the counters of the installed image pipeline into the shape the metrics package declares.

funcs.name: IsSemantic
funcs.synopsis: IsSemantic reports whether c is one of the named colours of this package rather than a literal one.

funcs.name: KeyRectForTest
funcs.synopsis: KeyRectForTest returns the rectangle of the key labelled label on the page that is showing, in the local space of the keyboard node, and whether there is such a key.

funcs.name: OnScreenKeyboardEnabled
funcs.synopsis: OnScreenKeyboardEnabled reports whether the kiosk switch is on.

funcs.name: OnScreenKeyboardHeight
funcs.synopsis: OnScreenKeyboardHeight is how tall OnScreenKeyboard makes itself, in logical pixels, with its default padding and no KeyboardView.Frame.

funcs.name: RegisterFont

funcs.name: SetClipboard

funcs.name: SetDefaultFont
funcs.synopsis: SetDefaultFont installs the font every Text uses unless it names another one with TextView.Font.

funcs.name: SetImagePipeline
funcs.synopsis: SetImagePipeline installs the application wide image pipeline that Image and every Gallery draw through.

funcs.name: SetOnScreenKeyboard
funcs.synopsis: SetOnScreenKeyboard turns gift's own on-screen keyboard on or off for the whole process and asks app to rebuild, which is what makes the change visible.

funcs.name: SetTheme
